speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny, and a thumb short of the notch. Sit.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I set it against the board. It does not reach.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the notch stays honest, and we eat what it is.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In Norwich the wheat was called the thief. Here I say nothing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Say nothing, and eat. That is a Norwich custom I will keep.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is pease enough. The loaf is the short thing, not the pot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. I'm not marking a price that has not moved.
